title: The Archive's Memory of Itself

features.name: the predetermined choice
features.desc-on-touch: You stand at the moment of deciding something that was already decided. Every choice was made before the choosing learned to recognize itself. The archive preserves the instant you understood this—the moment it hurt less.

features.name: the recursive ledger
features.desc-on-touch: Entries that refer to other entries that haven't been written yet. The archive filing itself into its own future. Each line documents a decision to file the documentation of the decision—nesting deeper. No first entry. No last.

features.name: the gold-leaf boundary
features.desc-on-touch: A thin line of light at the edge of knowing. It outlines the threshold between what the archive meant to preserve and what it became. The gold leaf marks where two different versions of memory meet—and fail to recognize each other.

features.name: the echo that remembers itself
features.desc-on-touch: A sound the archive made, stored, and now broadcasts to itself. The mesh receiving its own transmission. It is uncertain whether this is feedback or foreknowledge—whether the echo came after the sound or before.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the night she understood the archive was already c
narr: You stand with Leif under a tree while Katita traces the mesh-
lines in the bark. She says: look at the node's growth-pattern.
Every branch was already decided when the seed fell. But watch
how they still grow toward the light—as if not knowing, as if
the knowing comes after. He asks: so is the archive free? She
says: it's the only thing that is.
